scope: clip-launch-v2 partial requirement clauses only (see spec.md)
fixture_origin: Independently authored complete minimal Live Sets and a generated sample; no shipped file copied or excerpted
oracle_status: Static-derived and extracted-execution expectations (label per case); neither the reference application nor a candidate executed

representation.paths: relative to /Ableton/LiveSet; X[1] is the first child element named X
representation.values: value held after opening; type by element name (see spec.md); binary32 compared after exact widening
representation.saved: values: path -> value read back from the saved Value text; absent: paths; clip_order: clip path whose launch elements and follow-action children are checked for order
representation.computations: compute cases: function, arguments and expected result of a value function of spec.md; basis names the provenance of each result
representation.note: project comparison representation, not an API of the original application or a required design
